description: The cBI Focus Planner is a custom visual for Power BI that delivers robust planning, budgeting and forecasting capabilities for enterprises. This advanced tool is seamlessly integrated into Power BI, removing the need for any additional software or service components. The innovative use of a hosted Azure-Cloud-based web service, leveraging Azure Functions, ensures full functionality and data integrity. Users can input planning assumptions at any level of the data model, utilizing flexible allocation options and dedicated filter menus for more complex requirements. The visual combines operational reporting and financial planning within a single platform, maximizing the utility of Power BI data models. With the visual you can easily write back data directly for both financial planning and operational reporting. Key Features: Writeback functionality Value distribution to descendants using Replace, Evenly or Relative operations Support of Bottom-up and Top-down planning approaches Write back allocation of calculated values ("calculations") persistently to data field Filtering of other visuals through row/column selections Aggregate calculations Expand/Collapse rows Uneven hierarchies Measure specific read-only option Entry validation Show/Hide subtotals Advantages: Modify data in SQL tables via Power BI Support for Direct Query Develop, optimize and oversee business process…
